🔥 Claude-Mods | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enhancing the functionality and user experience of Claude Code through installable plugins for better task management, session organization, and resource monitoring.
✨ Key Features: • Context, limits, and reset timers displayed next to the chat (CTX) • Continue long tasks after chat clearing using saved summaries (Handoff) • Multiple parallel sessions for project work (Threads)
📖 Summary: Claude Mods enhances the Claude Code AI assistant by providing plugins that help users manage context limits, continue long tasks after chat resets, organize multiple sessions, and monitor resource usage. These mods aim to improve productivity and workflow within the Claude Code environment.
